title: Bridge Glb Path Resolution
description: Fix places where bridge.glb and other metabolism representation files resolve to wrong paths (stale assets/semio/metabolism vs fixtures/kit/dev/metabolism/representations).
summary: Bridge pieces showed the puzzle 3D placeholder box because findTypeInKit only searched kit.types; metabolism keeps all kinds under typologies (root types count 0). Fixed by flattening typologies in findTypeInKit/findDesignInKit, normalizing representations {items} in sketchpadListTypeRepresentations, and routing piece mesh resolution through that helper. bridge.glb on disk (367772 bytes) was always correct — not swapped with placeholder.glb (771728 bytes).
